source_id: UC-GYM-001 Main Flow — create new club
purpose: Student Admin can create a new club with valid data; club is recorded with open status.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized. Valid student IDs for coordinator and co-coordinator. Valid faculty ID for councillor.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club name, description, allowed category, coordinator_id, co_coordinator_id, faculty_councillor_id via POST /api/v1/gymkhana/clubs/.
expected_result: HTTP 201. New club exists with status='open'. System confirms successful creation.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 Alternative Flow — invalid leader/faculty blocks creation
purpose: If any selected leader or faculty record is invalid, the system identifies the invalid assignment and no club is created.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. coordinator_id refers to a non-student user.
expected_result: HTTP 400. No partial club record created. Error response identifies the invalid assignment.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 Main Flow — book club session
purpose: Club Head books a session in a configured venue with valid time range and no conflict; students are notified.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club. Configured venue available. No conflicting booking.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ with venue, booking_date, start_time < end_time, description.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Session stored. Notification task enqueued. System confirms booking.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 Alternative Flow — slot conflict rejects booking
purpose: If the requested slot overlaps an existing session or event, the booking is rejected.
preconditions: An existing booking occupies venue V on date D, 10:00-12:00. Club Head authenticated.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. No conflicting session created. Actor informed to select another slot.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 Main Flow — book club event
purpose: Club Head books a club event with valid event details, faculty councillor, venue, times, poster, description; students notified.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club. Valid faculty councillor. Configured venue. No conflict.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Event stored. Notification task enqueued.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 Alternative Flow — event-session cross-type overlap rejected
purpose: An event booking that overlaps an existing session in the same venue on the same date is rejected.
preconditions: Session occupies venue V, date D, 10:00-12:00. Club Head authenticated.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/event/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. Event not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 Main Flow — apply for club membership
purpose: Student submits a membership application to a confirmed club with description; application recorded as open.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Confirmed club exists. No prior application from this student to this club.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/memberships/apply/ with club id and description.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Application with status='open' created.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 Alternative Flow — multi-club application allowed
purpose: A student with an existing application to Club A can apply to a different Club B.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Existing application to Club A. Club B is confirmed and different.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Application for Club B created.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 Exception Flow — duplicate same-club application rejected
purpose: If a duplicate same-club application is detected, the system rejects it and leaves the existing application unchanged.
preconditions: Student has an existing open application to Club A.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Original application status unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 Main Flow — approve club membership
purpose: Club Head selects an open application, optionally adds remarks, and approves it; status transitions to confirmed.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Open application exists for the club.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Application status='confirmed'. Remarks stored.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 Exception Flow — non-open or wrong-club application not changed
purpose: If an application is no longer open or does not belong to the actor's club, it is not changed.
preconditions: Club Head of Club A tries to approve an application belonging to Club B.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/memberships/{id}/approve/ where the application belongs to Club B.
expected_result: HTTP 403 or 404. Application not changed.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 Main Flow — create voting poll
purpose: Club Head creates an active poll with title, description, expiration date, at least two choices, target groups by batch/branch; target students notified.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/polls/ with valid data including at least two choices and at least one target group.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Poll with status='active', choices, and target groups created. Notification task enqueued.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 Exception Flow — fewer than two choices rejects poll
purpose: If fewer than two choices are supplied, the poll is not created.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Poll not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Main Flow — vote in poll
purpose: Eligible targeted student views an active poll, selects a choice, and the vote is recorded with tally incremented.
preconditions: Active unexpired poll exists. Student belongs to target batch/branch. Student has not voted.
action_or_input: GET /api/v1/gymkhana/polls/{id}/ then POST /api/v1/gymkhana/polls/{id}/vote/ with valid choice_id.
expected_result: GET returns poll and choices. POST returns HTTP 200/201. Vote recorded. Choice tally incremented.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Exception Flow — already voted, ineligible, or expired poll rejected
purpose: If the student has already voted, is not eligible, or the poll is not active, the vote is rejected and tally unchanged.
preconditions: Student has already cast a vote in the poll.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. Vote not recorded. Tally unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 Main Flow — change club leadership
purpose: Authorized Club Head replaces coordinator and co-coordinator with valid students; previous leaders are superseded.
preconditions: Club exists. Authenticated user is current coordinator or co-coordinator. Proposed new leaders are valid students.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/clubs/{id}/leadership/ with new coordinator_id and co_coordinator_id.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Club references only the new coordinator and co-coordinator.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 Exception Flow — invalid proposed leader preserves existing leadership
purpose: If either proposed leader is invalid or the actor is unauthorized, the current leadership remains unchanged.
preconditions: Club exists. Authenticated user is not a Club Head (unauthorized).
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/clubs/{id}/leadership/ with valid new leader IDs but unauthorized caller.
expected_result: HTTP 403. Leadership unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 Main Flow — request club budget
purpose: Club Head submits a budget request with non-negative amount, purpose, description, and supporting file; stored with status='open'.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club. Non-negative amount and file provided.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Budget request with status='open' created.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 Exception Flow — negative amount or missing file rejected
purpose: If the amount is negative or the required file is missing, the request is rejected and not stored.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Budget request not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 Main Flow — submit club event report
purpose: Club Head submits event report with club, student_incharge, event_name, event_date, description, and report_file; report stored.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club. All required fields including report_file provided.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Event report stored and available.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 Exception Flow — missing report file or invalid references rejected
purpose: If the required report file or required references are missing/invalid, the report is not accepted.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Report not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 Main Flow — approve club
purpose: Student Admin approves an open club; status changes to confirmed.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. Club exists with status='open'.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Club status='confirmed'.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 Exception Flow — approval of non-open club fails
purpose: If the club is not open (e.g. already confirmed), no approval transition occurs.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. Club already has status='confirmed'.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. Status unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-012 Main Flow — review club event report
purpose: Assigned Club Faculty Councillor can list and access submitted event reports for their club.
preconditions: Faculty Councillor authenticated and assigned to Club X. At least one report submitted for Club X.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Response includes reports for Club X. Councillor can access report details and file.

source_id: UC-GYM-012 Exception Flow — unassigned faculty denied access
purpose: If the faculty user is not assigned to the club, the system denies access to that club's reports.
preconditions: Faculty member authenticated but not assigned as councillor to Club X. Reports exist for Club X.
expected_result: HTTP 403, 404, or empty list. No unauthorized report content exposed.
